# Competitor Intelligence

## Procedure
Sample multiple videos and channels; record source/video URL and date; extract high-level principles but do not copy text, footage, voice, brand assets, or exact trade dress.

## Evidence and safety
Never invent access, API responses, metrics, sources, or licenses. Label estimates and confidence. Follow approval gates in `CLAUDE.md` and produce an explicit result plus next test.
